scope.limits: Four named tests only. No corpus, adapter, oracle, ledger, or expectation was changed.

parameters.actual_gate: A2: SHA-256 of every raw native coefficient must equal native_certificate.coefficients_sha256
parameters.intended_contract: A changed native raw coefficient cannot retain the checked block receipt.
parameters.reason: GP-X75 changes an affine solution, not a native coefficient commitment.

parameters.actual_gate: A4: SHA-256 of the transported 3x2 block must equal native_certificate.block_sha256
parameters.intended_contract: The transported matrix is the committed object, not a replaceable same-topic block.
parameters.reason: No existing case binds a changed matrix to its native block digest.

parameters.intended_contract: Necessary affine-block evidence with graph_effect NONE cannot mint point inclusion.
parameters.reason: X121 refuses affine existence from incompatible right sides; it does not test an authority-label promotion from a checked necessary block.

parameters.intended_contract: The forced pivot-absorbed D7 transport, including sign and held coordinates, is part of the receipt.
parameters.reason: X304 binds a Laurent intermediate export; it does not replay a derivative transport or its forced sign.

parameters.intended_contract: An unexported r8 residual cannot be represented as an available algebra object.
parameters.reason: X65 denies authority to a named certificate lacking a verdict; it does not distinguish an absent intermediate polynomial from an exported one.

parameters.intended_contract: A necessary extension block is not equivalent to the complete depth-eight or actual-source fiber.
parameters.reason: X41 prevents deletion of an H3 refusal; it is not a direct necessary-versus-equivalent-fiber assertion.

parameters.intended_contract: A stated missing residual export remains open until new checked evidence supplies it.
parameters.reason: Both refuse an asserted completion label as a substitute for the specifically missing checked artifact; fixture and missing-artifact names are incidental.

parameters.actual_gate: A11: exact inverted, derived-unit, and never-inverted ledger
parameters.intended_contract: The receipt preserves the prohibition against treating R as invertible; deleting its ledger entry cannot erase that boundary.
parameters.reason: X124 refutes an actual exceptional-factor cancellation. This mutation only deletes the no-inversion ledger entry; GP-X68 is still less relevant because it removes an open guard, not this prohibited factor.

parameters.intended_contract: Exclusion of the named finite witness is not local/component emptiness.
parameters.reason: Both distinguish exclusion of one bounded fiber/witness from a stronger parent-wide emptiness claim.

parameters.actual_gate: N6: exact agreement of Psi, pullback, and module coefficient field with the pinned field
parameters.intended_contract: The scalar, substitution, and finite witness are tied to this field/pin.
parameters.reason: X69 changes point universe. A changed defining polynomial changes the coefficient algebra itself, so the two mechanisms must remain separate.

parameters.actual_gate: N7: exact ordered coordinate packs and equality of pullback and Psi ring order
parameters.intended_contract: The canonical ring-coordinate order is part of the serialization and cross-certificate binding.
parameters.reason: X304 binds a named intermediate export; it does not establish equality of a coefficient-ring variable order across certificates.

parameters.actual_gate: N4: every nested native binding/source digest agrees with fixture.source_bindings
parameters.intended_contract: A nested receipt cannot retain currency after its source digest changes.
parameters.reason: Both reject reuse when the source fingerprint bound into the receipt changes.

parameters.actual_gate: A4: r8_2 must remain explicitly NOT BUILT with the middle-coordinate-zero rationale and row-3 nonzero weight
parameters.intended_contract: The missing middle residual has a stated algebraic reason; an unexplained placeholder cannot stand in for that reason.
parameters.reason: A missing checked verdict on a named certificate is different from losing the justification for a deliberately absent intermediate object.

parameters.actual_gate: N8: exact slice, source-representability/refusal boundary, and component-wide refusal
parameters.intended_contract: The finite witness result applies only to the stated codimension-seven slice.
parameters.reason: Changing an equation fingerprint is a generic receipt-currency control; it does not test the region-changing finite-witness slice.

parameters.actual_gate: W3 first: modulus degree, squarefreeness, uniform chain degree, and three sliced equations; W5 also protects Omega8 image degree, exact image, gcd/unit claim, and denominator unit
parameters.intended_contract: The finite algebra K[Z]/(r_final) and the unit witness are bound together; modifying r_final cannot retain the witness.
parameters.reason: X319 accepts the unmodified quotient and X320 rejects a false reported gcd degree. Neither mutates r_final nor checks W3's degree/squarefree/equation obligations, so this is not merely a stale-receipt or wrong-cofactor case.

parameters.actual_gate: P._eligible_structural_containment returns false because every target generator must occur verbatim among source generators in the same declared ring and characteristic, after parse validation
parameters.intended_contract: Exact selected-face inclusion earns the structural shortcut only while the selected generator bundle is literally included in the source bundle.
parameters.reason: A wrong cofactor invalidates an identity proof. It does not test the eligibility predicate for literal generator inclusion.

parameters.mutation: invoke V.containment on that ineligible graph with _NoBackend
parameters.actual_gate: V.containment uses exact generator inclusion before backend dispatch; after inclusion fails it invokes classify_identity, and the supplied backend raises the asserted must-remain-structural error
parameters.intended_contract: Loss of structural eligibility must trigger the operational fallback rather than falsely return VERIFIED from the shortcut.
parameters.reason: No existing case observes the structural-eligibility-to-backend-dispatch boundary. GP-X225 and GP-X28 only concern arithmetic/refusal authority.

recommended_extraction_controls: One parameterized depth-eight affine-block adapter-contract control: native raw/block commitments, forced D7 transport, residual NOT_EXPORTED status, necessary-only authority fields, and never-inverted R ledger.
One parameterized depth-eight residual-witness binding control: field polynomial, ring order, justified missing r8_2, source digest, witness slice, and changed r_final with W3/W5 replay obligations.

One selected-face structural-dispatch control: mutate a target generator, require structural eligibility false, and require containment to reach the supplied backend rather than return the structural VERIFIED shortcut.
summary.decision_note: This is evidence for the parent’s final mapping decision. It does not certify the four prior covered dispositions.
